rules.rationale: The A13 branch-head patch adjusts FFmpeg Android make integration and Ut Video codec sources. Android 16 retains every surviving line and adds only media-stack adaptations required by current headers and libraries.
rules.necessity: Required to build the FFmpeg codec backend consumed by Stagefright plugins.
rules.performance: Build-system changes have no runtime cost; codec source fixes preserve the intended FFmpeg execution path.
rules.security: Codec parsers handle untrusted media. The A16 adaptation must remain covered by malformed-media and playback regression.
validation_evidence: All four A13 files have complete line evidence in Android 16 and target commit b58396a9 records the current adaptation.

rules.rationale: The four A13 patches evolve codec XML registration and FFmpeg extractor/audio behavior for Instagram/Facebook reels and Duolingo sound. Android 16 preserves the final XML exactly and all surviving extractor/audio lines while adapting to the A16 media APIs.
rules.necessity: Required for the known social-video and game/application audio compatibility cases.
rules.performance: Adds FFmpeg codec fallback/selection work only for affected media; no system-wide polling or frame-loop service is introduced.
rules.security: Expands media formats handled by native code, so malformed media remains a security-sensitive regression area.
validation_evidence: Final media_codecs_ffmpeg.xml is exact; extractor and SoftFFmpegAudio have complete line evidence; target commit 6462e1ed contains the A16 adaptation.
